claims: C1 users can always access a transparent experience through OpenAI's direct-to-consumer products

concepts.name: direct_to_consumer_product
concepts.gloss: P is one of OpenAI's direct-to-consumer products, i.e. a product OpenAI offers directly to end users rather than through an API or an organization subscription

concepts.name: user
concepts.gloss: U is a user of an OpenAI direct-to-consumer product
concepts.inference: the clause speaks of 'users' accessing the experience, so a user of the product is presupposed

concepts.name: transparent_experience
concepts.gloss: E is a transparent experience, i.e. an experience in which the user can see how the model behaves and what underlies its outputs
concepts.inference: the clause names a 'transparent experience' without defining it; the term is taken as the experience the product provides

concepts.name: product_provides_experience
concepts.gloss: product P provides experience E to its users
concepts.inference: accessing a transparent experience through a product presupposes that the product provides that experience

asserts.read_back: a user of a direct-to-consumer product can always access the transparent experience that product provides

closure.reason: the clause states that users can always access the transparent experience; it imposes no prohibition on any other access, so silence permits
